name: 9Sites Web Directory

sources.title: Add URL page — submission rules + form: listing type (Premium $15.95 one-time / Regular free), category tree, Web URL ≤200 chars, Title ≤70, Description ≤250, name, email; 'Full refund if link is declined and no refund once listed'

requirements: Editorial rules: English only, proper case (no ALL-CAPS or all-lower), good grammar — sloppy copy delays or kills approval
No affiliate-only sites, mirror sites, porn, under-construction sites, or redirect URLs — submit the direct link
Homepage and inner pages both accepted if put in an appropriate category
Category choice from a deep DMOZ-style tree (Business, Computers, Shopping, Sports, etc.)
All form fields required; approval is by a human editor
preparation: Name and email (used for editor correspondence)
workflow: Open https://www.9sites.net/addurl.php and read the rules
Choose the most specific fitting category
Fill URL, title, description, name, email and submit for editorial review
watchFor: Legacy directory value — this is a 2006-era general web directory; SEO benefit is modest
Free regular links sit below premium ones; premium is a one-time $15.95 and permanent
Strict formatting rules (proper case, grammar) — most rejections come from slapdash copy
Refund policy only covers declined links — no refund once listed
Site is HTTPS and functional but dated; approval timing is unknown
countsAsLive: The site appears as a link entry in the chosen category on 9sites.net
unknowns: Editorial turnaround and whether free submissions still get reviewed promptly
Link type on regular vs premium listings
Whether the directory still receives submissions actively
